data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104 opened 2019 with gross claims outstanding of $139.629m (31/12/2018). During 2019 there was an adverse prior-year movement (gross) of $22.18m (15.9% of opening reserves), recorded as an "under/over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses", resulting in a net strengthening of reserves. The movement is consistent with adverse development on property catastrophe reinsurance exposures driven by large natural catastrophe events and related large-loss development. The syndicate notes prior-year reserve impacts from the 2017 hurricanes and California wildfires ($32.6m reserved) and the 2018 hurricanes, typhoons and Northern California wildfires ($49.7m reserved).

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts are reported in the Syndicate's functional currency (USD). Opening reserves (139.629) taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (claims outstanding) comparative 2018 column. Prior-year development (22.18) is the GROSS 'Under/over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses' from the Technical Provisions note. Claims development triangle is present and retained in raw 'thousands' units; RITC does not distort the 2019 Syndicate 6104 triangle (no material RITC entries for 6104). No explicit textual attribution in the note links the 22.18m to a single named event; aggregate catastrophe reserves for 2017/2018 are provided separately and have been noted.
